note: Approved UI compositions. Validated by `make check-classes` (every source exists, every listed class appears there, every doc anchor resolves, and every composition in docs/ui-compositions.md has an entry). Written for LLM agents: `go run ./cmd/ui-registry list` / `show <id>`.

entries.title: Account row (rail footer)
entries.when: the signed-in user's identity in the sidebar footer; the panel that holds their preferences
entries.avoid: icon toggles beside the identity row, or a panel opening downward from the bottom edge

entries.title: Preference row (inside the account panel)
entries.when: a theme/palette choice the user owns
entries.avoid: two controls for the same choice (a sun/moon toggle plus a palette list), or a palette control outside the account surface

entries.title: Empty state
entries.when: a list or card with nothing in it yet
entries.avoid: ad-hoc margins per page; the glyph is decorative, the copy is the content

entries.title: Field plus its action
entries.when: an input and the button that submits it
entries.avoid: a bare wrapper div; pair the sizes (input-sm with btn-sm) or the joined pair reads as broken

entries.title: Stack key (demo panel evidence)
entries.when: the `How it works` panel of a page that declares Data.Stack
entries.avoid: the sidebar, a counter in the label, or a per-page invention

entries.title: State, inline
entries.when: counts, verdicts, roles and statuses next to a row or a title
entries.avoid: putting `badge` on an element and stripping its padding/border/background in a scoped rule
